title: Minimum Health to Beat Game
summary: You are playing a game with n levels, numbered from 0 to n-1.
statement: You are playing a game with n levels, numbered from 0 to n-1. Each level reduces your health by a specific amount as given in the 0-indexed integer array damage, where damage[i] represents the health loss for completing the i-th level. You also have an armor that can protect you from up to a certain amount of damage, but you can use it at most once during the game on any level. You must complete the levels in order and maintain a health level above zero to beat the game. Determine the minimum health you need to start the game to ensure you can complete all levels with health always above zero.
constraints: Every level deals its listed positive damage and health must remain strictly above zero.
Armor may be used once and prevents min(level damage,armor) damage.
Return the minimum integer starting health needed to survive all levels.
hints: Only total damage and the largest preventable single hit matter.
Use armor on the largest damage level, reducing total loss by min(max_damage,armor).
Armor’s reduction is monotone in the chosen hit, so the largest hit is optimal; one extra point is necessary and sufficient for positive final health.
